title: RAW nested sieve cuts constrain the frozen powder reading beyond mass balance
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_EXECUTED. Preserve every value and complete clause of the f21r/f32v powder-partition offer. A deterministic sieve-cut refinement makes repeated separation idempotent at the same cut: the coarse f32v.8 output cannot yield two positive pass/retained products at .9 without a changed cut or a particle-changing operation. The complete offered reading contains no intervening regrinding. This exposes a concrete physical parameter needed by a more literal sieve reading, not a refutation of the original SORT value or new word evidence.

design.mechanism: Physical grade partition acts on particles whose sieve behavior persists across lifting and storage. A second partition of an already retained coarse branch by the same deterministic cut is idempotent. A later positive pass fraction therefore constrains either the second cut or an explicitly written intervening particle transformation.
design.unit: The entire already offered f32v.7–11 reading, with the full f21r.8–12 reading as a required countercase. No extracted quantity window is the semantic unit.
design.contrast: FIXED_CUT: one invariant effective cut for a grade partition and subsequent sieve sorting. NESTED_CUT: keep the same literal operation meanings but permit a separately recorded ordered cut parameter. Also retain the original weaker SORT reading, which does not explicitly assert pass/retained outputs and is therefore not refuted by this refinement.
design.prediction: Under the additional deterministic one-dimensional pass/retain contract, both positive .9 products from the .8 coarse branch require a second cut strictly above the first if no intervening particle-size change occurs. Equal or finer cut cannot do it. In f21r a positive residue from re-sieving the previously fine branch would conversely require a strictly finer cut; the current draft permits an empty residue, so it does not presently impose that second inequality.

fixed_parent.unchanged: All65 primary values,15 explicit alternate-form assumptions, all original raw groups, literal scopes, full counterversions, quantity and identity rivals remain unchanged. This is a separate refinement, never a patch to the parent.
relevant_written_chain: f32v.7: ROOT_MATERIAL;CRUSH;DRY OVERNIGHT IN_SHADE;THEN MIX PREPARED_BULK THOROUGHLY EVENLY.
f32v.8: COARSE_GRIST 2Q and POWDER Q;SEPARATE_BY_GRADE;LIFT_OUT the COARSE_FRACTION.
f32v.9: SORT WITH_SIEVE;KEEP FIBRES Q and GRANULES Q.
f32v.10–11: WATER+OIL+available FINE POWDER Q;KNEAD TO one PASTE portion;GRIND with its contained WATER.
fixed_parent.full_context_obligation: All five lines and all earlier/later claims remain. The same coarse branch feeds .9 only under the parent CARRY/partition-focus contract; no hidden replacement, grinding, breakage, fresh particles or unprinted tool change is supplied.

additional_assumptions_not_already_prove: Each particle has one stable effective grade g relevant to both chosen separations. Shape, orientation, agglomeration, moisture, deformation and variable passage do not change its classification between these two operations. This is an idealized conditional model, not asserted sieve physics in all workshops.
The first grade partition uses a fixed threshold t: fine particles satisfy g<=t;coarse satisfy g>t.

SORT WITH_SIEVE physically forms one passing and one retained fraction using another threshold u, and the two written positive products FIBRES and GRANULES exhaust those two outputs. Which named product passes is unresolved and must not be guessed here; either direction entails two nonempty outputs.
LIFT_OUT, KEEP and storage preserve particle grade. CRUSH/GRIND may change it, but none occurs between .8 and .9 in the offered complete reading.
Mass positivity from Q>0 entails that both physical output fractions contain material; no full probability or exact particle-size distribution is introduced.

small_derivation.coarse_input: For every particle x in C, g(x)>t.
small_derivation.positive_passing_product: There must be at least one x in C with g(x)<=u. Thus t<g(x)<=u, implying u>t.
small_derivation.positive_retained_product: There must also be y in C with g(y)>u. A larger second cut is necessary, not sufficient; input must straddle it.
small_derivation.same_cut_adverse_model: For u=t, no x can both satisfy g(x)>t and g(x)<=t. A second positive passing output cannot exist. The same impossibility holds for u<t.
small_derivation.fine_input_countercase: For the already fine f21r branch, all g(x)<=t. A second positive retained remainder requires some g(x)>u and hence u<t. If the entire fine input passes at u=t, the remainder can be empty, which the parent allows.
small_derivation.why_not_mass_balance: All quantities may conserve exactly while the required pass fraction is empty under the fixed cut. The restriction concerns material classification and allowable operations, not whether Q+Q equals2Q.

plausible_rivals_and_adverse_cases: The current parent says SEPARATE_BY_GRADE, not explicitly one fixed sieve or mesh. A coarse branch can later be sorted using a larger mesh; this preserves every old word value. Therefore the parent is not currently contradicted.

SORT may mean manual or morphological sorting with a sieve involved as a tool, without an asserted pass/retained binary. That weaker literal hypothesis does not satisfy this refinement and remains separate.

Real long fibres and granules may have different orientation-dependent passage. A single scalar grade can fail even with the same physical mesh. A failure of the idealization is not a Voynich word refutation.

A new whole paragraph could explicitly supply a different cut, regrinding, altered medium or a fresh branch; if written and bound before judgement, that would change the premises. It may not be silently supplied to rescue a contrary case.
The f21r re-sieving sequence is not a counterexample merely because it repeats an operation: its final residue is allowed to be empty. Do not manufacture a positive residue to force a second result.

later_use_and_capacity.immediate_small_review: At most15minutes to review the existing two whole readings and explicitly decide whether a literal pass/retained sieve contract is intended. No simulator, decoder, corpus run or new target is required for the displayed conditional implication.
later_use_and_capacity.target_rule: This proposal nominates no manuscript target. If IDEA000514 or a separately preregistered root specification selects one entire extension, the same fixed values may be inspected for an actually written second-separation consequence. This proposal must neither influence its rank nor nominate a replacement.
later_use_and_capacity.capacity_required: A complete parent-preserving reading with two linked grade partitions, the carried branch identity, no unresolved intervening transformation, two positive later output requirements, and a written or explicitly frozen cut relation. Without these, MISSING_BINDING/NO_CAPACITY for a manuscript discriminator.
later_use_and_capacity.future_outcomes: A bound incompatible cut relation rejects only the exact refined reading. A compatible larger cut remains an unconfirmed parameter assumption. If cut identity or product route is unwritten, preserve the gap; do not translate an unknown word as SAME_SIEVE solely to enable a test.
later_use_and_capacity.new_costs: Zero new word denotations or source admissions in this card. Two symbolic cut parameters and their order, one scalar-grade idealization, one binary pass/retained interpretation and carried-particle persistence are the explicit new freedoms. No numerical mesh values, fitted probabilities or free per-occurrence exceptions.

predecessors.difference: The old binary-threshold idea has no particular linked material process. This proposal supplies an actual full reading and a second-step idempotence/nested-cut consequence. No state marker becomes translated.
The new invariant is particle classification between two splits, not conserved total mass. The original missing raw semantic discriminator remains.

Formation/separation cannot be selected from a product noun alone. Here the complete parent explicitly carries a coarse branch into a second action, but the physical cut relation is still additional and unconfirmed.
No old property or identity value is imported, no drying step inserted and no distant state label used as independent endpoint.
No ratio closure, numeric value selection or simulated amount/quality score.

claim_ceiling: A conditional semantic constraint and an exposed modeling freedom in an already complete hypothetical reading. No experimental outcome, independently grounded material, identified source or confirmed word.
